description:
List the charts saved in the connected FateTell account: id, display name, gender, whether it is the user's own chart, hemisphere, chart rule version and whether the chart has been computed.
Use first whenever the user refers to "my chart", a family member's chart or any saved profile, to get the chart_id that get_saved_chart, get_bazi_judgment, get_daily_fortune and get_chart_calendar need. Do not ask for birth data when a saved chart may exist.
Not for creating charts (use create_saved_chart) or reading a chart's content (use get_saved_chart).
Birthplace and coordinates are never returned.
name: list_saved_charts

birth_date.description: Gregorian birth date, YYYY-MM-DD; given to tell charts apart.

chart_id.description: Pass to get_saved_chart, get_bazi_judgment, get_daily_fortune or get_chart_calendar.

chart_ready.description: False while the chart is still being computed or cannot be read.

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere of the stored chart; null while the chart is not ready.

is_self.description: True for the account holder's own chart.

paipan_version.description: Chart rule version. Charts computed now are always v1 (FateTell cross-region rules).

engine_version.description: FateTell calculation engine version (package version + commit).

links.description: FateTell web pages for objects in this result, for citation. Only objects already present in the result are linked.

rel.description: Which FateTell page this is: chart, daily_fortune, luck_pillars or account.

url.description: Page in the FateTell web app for an object that appears in this result.

notes.description: Codes for facts that qualify this result: hour_assumed (no birth time, 12:00 used), true_solar_skipped_no_longitude, southern_month_adjusted, palace_formula_lunar_javascript (life and body palaces follow the lunar-javascript formula), legacy_v0_chart, judgment_unavailable, chart_pending, truncated, lunar_converted (the birth date was given in the lunar calendar and converted to Gregorian).

title: List saved charts
